fact: ARCEP Gabon, named lead country of the One Africa Network, reported at a 2-4 June 2026 Lagos workshop free roaming in the CEMAC zone covering 100% of operators in Congo and Equatorial Guinea and 83-87% in Chad, Cameroon and CAR, a 91% overall rate for Gabon.
title: L'ARCEP Gabon à Lagos pour l'intégration numérique africaine : cap sur le One Africa Network
